display_long_description:
RaceFault VR Car Racing delivers a fast, arcade-style, high-adrenaline racing experience built for Meta Quest. Drift through neon cities, race across volcanic cliffs, and blast through futuristic anti-gravity tracks with responsive VR controls and cinematic speed.

🔥 Why Players Love RaceFault VR Car Racing

• 6 unique cars with different speeds, handling, and upgrade paths
• 10 action-packed levels including neon highways, lava cliffs, and cyber anti-gravity zones
• AI Companion Girls (Luna, Nova, Aurora & more) who cheer, react, and celebrate your driving
• Drift, Nitro & Turbo Boosts tuned for smooth VR comfort and arcade fun
• Customizations — unlock skins, nitro kits, horns & performance upgrades
• Easy to learn, addictive to master — perfect for short sessions and long racing marathons

🚗 Gameplay Experience

Feel every drift, crash, and turbo push with immersive VR physics designed for Meta Horizon. Each track brings new challenges: dense traffic, steep cliffs, tight corners, and high-speed jumps.

Your companion reacts to your skills — from perfect drifts to near crashes — making every race feel alive and personal.

🏆 Compete, Upgrade & Dominate

Earn coins, unlock cars, master tracks. More updates, events, and cars are coming.

Compatible with Quest 2 / Quest 3 / Quest Pro
Comfort: Moderate

Download now and start your VR racing journey in RaceFault VR Car Racing!
